items.title: The DES file
items.text: Rare disease, few subjects, speed, low cost, several causes at once, no follow-up, few ethical problems.

items.title: The recall question
items.text: Memory and old records whose accuracy cannot be checked.

items.title: The hospital door
items.text: Choosing a suitable comparison group is hard.

items.title: Your odds ratio
items.text: No incidence; cause not separated from what travels with it; not for treatments; representativeness uncertain.
